kind: prospective Criterion-coverage amendment; fixtures, resources, sampling, flame graph settings, iteration counts, every existing Criterion case and every acceptance rule are unchanged
cause: Two indra-engine Criterion benches were never built into the profile export, so neither produced a measurement under the one- and two-CPU limits. benches/language_model.rs times the pure-Rust Indra OCR 1.1 additions: n-gram log-probability lookups, the LM beam search that the default recognition path runs, and the bidi flip. benches/continuous.rs times serial versus continuous batch selection for the opt-in continuous-batching pilot.

observed_gap.observation: criterion-results.jsonl holds the 46 declared cases at each CPU cap, all from the postprocessing, control_path, verification and propagation benches; no lm_logp, beam_search, rtl_flip or continuous_selection case exists

changed_protocol_fields.reason: Paired Criterion arms that later measure a row-sum change append their full case identities here; expected_total_cases and amended_protocol_sha256_after are recomputed in the same change

execution_changes: docker/native.Dockerfile builds the language_model and continuous benches into the engine-profile-export bundle and checks them for static linkage
scripts/profile-native.sh runs both benches in the Criterion phase, requires them in the bundle and takes the expected case count from criterion.expected_total_cases
scripts/admit-native-profile.py derives the case set from the protocol and requires its length to equal criterion.expected_total_cases
phase_budget: Run 39839055833 finished the 46-case Criterion phase in 210 s at each CPU cap. At the same cost per case the 77 cases need about 350 s, inside the unchanged 900 s phase limit.
